1.

Heard learned counsel for the applicants, learned AGA for the State as also Shri Pranshu Mishra,
learned Counsel for the opposite party nos. 2 to 4 and perused the record.

2. Instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been preferred by the applicant(s) for quashing the entire proceedings of Non-Bailable Warrant order dated 25.09.2023 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 13, Pratapgarh under Sections 147, 148, 149, 354(Kha), 323, 504,
506, 325, 452, 376-D IPC at Police Station - Raniganj, District - Pratapgarh as well as Case Crime No. 0112/2023 under Sections 147, 148, 149, 354(Kha), 323, 504, 506, 307, 452, IPC at Police Station - Raniganj, District - Pratapgarh.

sentences.text: 3. It is stated that this Court vide its order dated 18.11.2023 referred the matter to the trial court for the purpose of verification of the compromise entered into between the parties.

sentences.text: 6. Learned counsel for the opposite parties could not dispute the fact that the compromise has been entered into between the parties and now the private respondent does not want to proceed with the proceedings in issue.

7. Considering the submissions advanced by learned counsel for the parties and perusing the order of trial Court dated 11.12.2023 as also taking note of the observations made by Hon'ble Apex Court in the judgments referred above and the nature of dispute/crime, which is essentially a matrimonial dispute, this Court is of the view that no purpose would be served in keeping the proceedings pending before the trial court and hence, the same are hereby quashed in terms of the compromise and the present application is allowed.
Order Date :- 14.6.2024/Mohit Singh/-
